genericDFX.name: Logging & Diagnostics
genericDFX.summary: SLF4J with Lombok @Slf4j used on 90% of service classes. MDC configured in filter. Logstash JSON encoder in logback-spring.xml.

genericDFX.name: Exception Handling
genericDFX.summary: Global @RestControllerAdvice with hierarchical business exceptions and standardized ErrorResponse DTO.

genericDFX.name: Metrics & Monitoring
genericDFX.summary: Micrometer and Prometheus configured. @Timed used on some services but inconsistent. No custom business counters defined.
recommendations: Add @Timed on PaymentService and InventoryService methods
Define custom business counters (orders.created, payments.failed)

genericDFX.name: Health Checks
genericDFX.summary: Actuator health enabled with custom indicators for DB, Redis, MQ. Liveness/readiness probes configured.

genericDFX.name: Circuit Breakers
genericDFX.summary: Resilience4j dependency present. @CircuitBreaker on payment gateway call but not on logistics or SMS calls.
recommendations: Add @CircuitBreaker on LogisticsClient and SmsService calls
Review slidingWindowSize configuration for production

genericDFX.name: Caching
genericDFX.summary: @Cacheable on product and category reads. @CacheEvict on writes. Redis cache with per-region TTL configured.

genericDFX.name: Retry
genericDFX.summary: @Retryable on payment callback processor but no @Recover method defined.
recommendations: Add @Recover methods for all @Retryable operations

genericDFX.name: Distributed Tracing
genericDFX.summary: No OpenTelemetry or Sleuth dependencies found.
recommendations: Add opentelemetry-spring-boot-starter dependency
Configure OTLP exporter to Jaeger/Zipkin
Add @WithSpan on critical business methods

genericDFX.name: Thread Pool & Async
genericDFX.summary: @Async used for email notification. Default SimpleAsyncTaskExecutor used instead of custom thread pool.
recommendations: Configure custom ThreadPoolTaskExecutor with bounded queue and rejection policy
Register thread pool metrics via MeterBinder

genericDFX.name: Configuration Management
genericDFX.summary: @ConfigurationProperties with validation on key configs. @RefreshScope on feature flags. Environment-specific YML files.

genericDFX.name: API Versioning
genericDFX.summary: Some controllers have /v1/ prefix but no /v2/ exists. No formal versioning strategy.
recommendations: Define an API versioning policy and implement consistent URL or header versioning

genericDFX.name: Graceful Shutdown
genericDFX.summary: server.shutdown=graceful not configured. No @PreDestroy cleanup hooks.
recommendations: Set server.shutdown=graceful and spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase=30s
Add @PreDestroy hooks to drain connections and complete in-flight tasks

genericDFX.name: Security DFX
genericDFX.summary: CORS configured with specific origins. No rate limiting on public endpoints.
recommendations: Add rate limiting on /api/auth and /api/checkout endpoints
Verify SecurityContext propagation in @Async methods

businessDFX.name: Order Idempotency
businessDFX.summary: Idempotency key accepted via X-Idempotency-Key header. Check-then-set not atomic (race condition risk).
recommendations: Use Redis SETNX or DB INSERT with unique constraint for atomic idempotency check
Add scheduled cleanup for expired idempotency keys

businessDFX.name: Inventory Lock & Release
businessDFX.summary: Redis distributed lock (Redisson) before inventory deduction. Release in finally block. WHERE stock >= quantity in SQL.

businessDFX.name: Payment Transaction
businessDFX.summary: Payment state machine with enum transitions. Webhook signature verification present. No scheduled reconciliation.
recommendations: Add scheduled payment reconciliation job comparing local records with gateway

businessDFX.name: Distributed Transactions
businessDFX.summary: No Saga, TCC, Seata, or Outbox pattern found. Cross-service consistency not guaranteed.
recommendations: Implement Outbox pattern for order-created events
Consider Seata AT or Saga for order-inventory-payment consistency

businessDFX.name: Flash Sale Protection
businessDFX.summary: No flash sale domain detected. No high-concurrency protections in place.
recommendations: If flash sales are planned: implement Redis pre-load, MQ queuing, per-user rate limiting

businessDFX.name: State Machine Monitoring
businessDFX.summary: No formal state machine library. State transitions via ad-hoc if/else. No stuck-order detection.
recommendations: Adopt a state machine library (Spring State Machine or stateless4j)
Add @Scheduled job to detect orders stuck in intermediate states

businessDFX.name: Third-Party Degradation
businessDFX.summary: Circuit breaker on payment gateway. SMS and logistics calls lack fallback.
recommendations: Add circuit breakers and fallback implementations for SMS and logistics services

businessDFX.name: Business Alert Metrics
businessDFX.summary: No business-level counters or alert thresholds found. Only system metrics (JVM, Tomcat).
recommendations: Define business counters: orders.created, payments.failed, stockout.count
Configure alert thresholds for order failure rate and payment timeout

businessDFX.name: User Journey Funnel
businessDFX.summary: No structured analytics events or funnel tracking found.
recommendations: Emit events at conversion points: product.viewed, cart.added, checkout.started, order.placed
Add funnel conversion Counter metrics

businessDFX.name: Timeout Management
businessDFX.summary: RestTemplate timeouts configured globally. No per-operation timeout differentiation.
recommendations: Configure distinct timeouts per operation type (payment=10s, search=2s, export=30s)

businessDFX.name: Data Reconciliation
businessDFX.summary: No scheduled reconciliation jobs found. No cross-system consistency checks.
recommendations: Add periodic reconciliation of order-payment status between local DB and payment gateway
Implement inventory consistency check job
